title: Resolution urging Albany to pass an auto insurance transparency law
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, the Automobile Insurance Consumer Information Act (S.1196/A.3983). The act would create an Office of Insurance Consumer Advocate to represent consumers in auto insurance rate cases, require the Department of Financial Services to post premium information online for comparison shopping, and let municipalities petition for rate changes. New York City drivers paid an average annual premium of $4,223 in 2025, nearly twice the national average.
